gameplay_identity: Player-owned interceptor whose facing and weapon centerline remain readable under maximum combat pressure.
silhouette_requirement: Forward point, symmetric wings, and separated engine line must read before interior color.
orientation_cue: The nose and centered muzzle are the dominant north-facing cue.

references.study: Read player ownership and facing at arcade combat density.
Study economical ship silhouettes and large editable parts.

avoid_rules: No microtexture, gradients, dithering, or lighting simulation.
Do not bake dash, damage flash, status, or weapon cooldown into the chassis.
